summary: Smoke tested 4 new features (Tours map, PDF+Signature, low-stock banner, CSV import) end-to-end. Backend endpoints (login, low-stock, geocode-all, PDF, CSV bulk-import) all return expected payloads. Frontend integration verified via Playwright: login OK, Leaflet map renders with markers on /tours, geocode-all-btn visible, PDF button triggers /api/orders/{id}/pdf returning 200 application/pdf, sign-btn opens SignaturePad canvas, csv-import-btn accepts file upload. Low-stock banner correctly hidden (0 items <30 in seed).
passed: Dashboard renders (banner absent as expected, no low stock)
Tours page: leaflet-container present, 1 marker rendered, geocode-all-btn visible
Orders page: 5 pdf-btn-* and 5 sign-btn-* buttons present; PDF fetch returns 200 application/pdf
Signature pad canvas opens on sign-btn click
Clients page: csv-import-btn present, hidden file input accepts CSV
notes: Only 1 marker visible on map (seed has few geocoded clients in Bordeaux/Marseille area). Low-stock banner data-testid not rendered because no products <30 threshold - this is correct conditional rendering, not a bug.
